This was a very serious and disappointing experience. I visited this store to exchange my gold for a chain. The chain was properly hallmarked as 22K gold.

After testing, they claimed the gold was only 19K. We were shocked. To verify, we immediately took the same gold to Kalyan Jewellers next door, where they remelted and tested it properly. The result came back as 22K gold.

What made this even more concerning was that the next day, the manager at Kalyan informed us that the manager from Malabar Gold & Diamonds had called them asking why they melted the gold again.

When we went back to question them, instead of resolving the issue professionally, the staff — including the bald staff member and the clean-shaven manager — behaved rudely and said, “It’s your wish if you don’t want to come back.”

Extremely disappointing experience. Customers should be very careful and always verify purity independently.

Of course when they took the ring they wanted to simply diffuse the situation and this was their easy way of getting me out of the store by accepting to do it after much hesitation and haggling.
